title: Stay where the heart is helped
summary: Holy company carries what the solitary mind cannot. Take the question into sangat.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation.

source.shortMeaning: Holy company carries what the solitary mind cannot.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it.

evidence.coreClaim: Holy company carries what the solitary mind cannot.
evidence.turn: Treat this life as a meeting, not an endless postponement.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation.
